title: Wyrmfall - A Dragon ARPG (Claude Opus)
author: Starstilanx
selftext:
Hello!

I wanted to share my game with all of you! It's called Wyrmfall. It's a game entirely about dragons with a bunch of elements inspired by Path of Exile. It was coded completely with Claude Opus 5. Art is by PixelLab and Gemini (Weapon, armor, and item sprite sheets). Sounds are from the Humble Bundle game dev audio packs that they occasionally release.

Currently, the web version doesn't work so far as I know from my own testing (I'm looking to fix that today), but the page has a ton of screenshots and information about the game. 

Let me know what you think!
